description: IT department of an industrial CNC machine manufacturer: upgraded an out-of-support Linux server after previous attempts had failed, and supported day-to-day IT operations.

areas.title: Server migration
tasks: Upgraded the server hosting the company's IT asset inventory from Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (EOL) to 24.04 LTS, after previous attempts had failed
Upgraded the asset management application (GLPI) from 10.0.18 to 11.0.7
Reconfigured the Apache2 virtual hosts and migrated the MySQL database without data loss
Driven by known vulnerabilities in the unsupported versions, as part of the ISO 27001 preparation; delivered ready for promotion to production

areas.title: IT operations
tasks: Managed computers in Active Directory with operator permissions
Supported users and shop-floor CNC software (Siemens, Heidenhain)
Automated recurring administrative tasks with Bash scripting

areas.title: Documentation
tasks: Wrote the department's technical documentation and internal procedures to standardise recurring tasks, still in use
